Now write SQL. Find Lewis Hamilton's earliest race (min year, then round/date), join results, get race name and points.

Note L3 says: dataset holds no 2007 Australian Grand Prix, so first race in data is Malaysian Grand Prix with points 8. The dataset's own query reads the cumulative standings value after that race (14) — do not report.

SQL: single row, single... well two columns: race name and points. That's fine — "行列表" allowed.

SELECT r.name, res.points
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.forename='Lewis' AND d.surname='Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year, r.round
LIMIT 1;
